description_en: Checks the processing status of an uploaded rule library. This operation returns the current status of the upload task, the size of the parsed rule library file, and its storage path
description_zh: 查询用户上传规则库的处理状态。通过该接口，用户可以查询到当前规则库上传任务的状态，并获取到解析后的规则库文件大小、存储路径等信息
kebab_example: aliyun aimiaobi get-audit-note-processing-status --workspace-id llm-xx --task-id xxx_Default_129873419274 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetAuditNoteProcessingStatus

parameters.help_en: Unique identifier of your Model Studio workspace. To get this ID, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.help_zh: 阿里云百炼业务空间唯一标识：获取https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/2782167.html
parameters.name: workspace_id

parameters.help_en: Task ID returned by the SubmitAuditNote operation. Save this ID securely. It uniquely identifies your custom rule library task
parameters.help_zh: 用户通过 SubmitAuditNote 接口得到的 TaskId。这是自定义规则库任务索引的唯一标识，在使用时务必妥善保存
parameters.name: task_id
